description: Work with patient charts and the schedule in Elation's EHR: find, add and update patients, book and update appointments, record problems, allergies and non-visit notes, and read medications, vitals, visit notes and reports.

elation_health_appointment_status_change.description: Runs when an appointment's status changes, such as to Checked In, Checked Out, Cancelled or Not Seen.

output.appointment: The record returned by the service

parameters.description: Only run when an appointment changes to this status. Leave empty for any change of status.
parameters.name: status

elation_health_appointment_updated_trigg.description: Runs when an appointment from yesterday to six months ahead changes: moved, its type, physician or status changed, or cancelled.

output.appointment: The record returned by the service

elation_health_new_allergy_trigger.description: Runs when an allergy is added to a patient's chart.

output.allergy: The record returned by the service

elation_health_new_appointment_trigger.description: Runs when an appointment is booked in Elation for any time from yesterday to six months ahead.

output.appointment: The record returned by the service

elation_health_new_chart_message_trigger.description: Runs when a message is added to a message thread in a patient's chart, by a patient or by staff.

output.message: The record returned by the service

elation_health_new_fax_trigger.description: Runs when a fax arrives in the practice's inbox.

output.fax: The record returned by the service

elation_health_new_lab_order_trigger.description: Runs when a lab order is placed for a patient.

output.lab_order: The record returned by the service

elation_health_new_medication_trigger.description: Runs when a medication is prescribed or recorded for a patient.

output.medication: The record returned by the service

elation_health_new_non_visit_note_trigge.description: Runs when a non-visit note, such as a phone call or email with a patient, is added to a chart.

output.non_visit_note: The record returned by the service

elation_health_new_patient_trigger.description: Runs when a patient is added to Elation, with their demographics.

output.patient: The record returned by the service

elation_health_new_problem_trigger.description: Runs when a problem (diagnosis) is added to a patient's problem list.

output.problem: The record returned by the service

elation_health_new_report_trigger.description: Runs when a report, such as a lab, imaging or consultation result, arrives in a patient's chart.

output.report: The record returned by the service

elation_health_new_visit_note_trigger.description: Runs when a visit note is started for a patient, signed or not.

output.visit_note: The record returned by the service

elation_health_new_vitals_trigger.description: Runs when vitals, such as blood pressure or weight, are recorded for a patient.

output.vitals: The record returned by the service

elation_health_patient_updated_trigger.description: Runs when a patient's details change in Elation, such as their address, phone number or status.

output.patient: The record returned by the service

elation_health_visit_note_signed_trigger.description: Runs when a physician signs a visit note.

output.visit_note: The record returned by the service
